invented: [minor] This is the latest whisper we have. (implies an ongoing trail of earlier whispers about Quell; the briefing gives no such history) | [minor] Another piece of local mischief. It also sounds odd to say the Dispatch is "they" when Ilse writes for it.

comment: It leads correctly with the new fact, but then pads with two whole items of old news, breaking the quiet-week rule. The wit is thin and generic, with meta lines like "This is the only news to report this cycle", so the dry voice does not come through.
